title: atomic_json prep-prefix rejection clause untested
description: Wave-1 review (security, P3): test/vectors/atomic_json.py:580 rejects targets starting with _PREPARATION_PREFIX but no batch-rejection test exercises it (parametrize at python/tests/test_vector_atomic_json.py:221-227 covers only the two exact reserved names). If that clause regresses, _recover_orphan_preparations (atomic_json.py:547-558) unconditionally deletes every prefix-named regular owned file at the start of the next batch - a committed target named .lichen-vector-prep-*.json would be silently destroyed. Add one parametrize entry. Discovered-from wave 1 bead project-LICHEN-worker6-blqw.
close_reason: Fixed in wave 1 follow-up: casefold guard + aliased regression, parametrize entry, fsync-ordering pin, hold-down constants, wait_for timeouts + ctime_ns. Suites green (44+178+130).
